text:
Which statement explains the meaning of the half-life of a radioactive isotope?
A
half the time taken for one nucleus of the isotope to decay
B
half the time taken for the isotope to decay completely
C
the time taken for half of the nuclei of the isotope to decay
D
the time taken for one nucleus of the isotope to split in half

options.label: A
options.text: half the time taken for one nucleus of the isotope to decay

options.label: B
options.text: half the time taken for the isotope to decay completely

options.label: C
options.text: the time taken for half of the nuclei of the isotope to decay

options.label: D
options.text: the time taken for one nucleus of the isotope to split in half
